ns2:course.label: Chicago Center Primary Care
ns2:course.description: This two week rotation is dedicated to small animal primary care at UIUC's Chicago Center for Veterinary Medicine. Students will work with faculty clinicians on general practice cases. Students will be responsible for seeing daily appointments, and will assist in management of common non-specialist-level medical and surgical cases. Exposure to principles of preventative medicine/wellness care and practice management are integral to this rotation, which is designed to give students opportunities for hands-on learning in a real-world, urban, private practice setting. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Limited to third and fourth year clinical DVM students.
